comment: elliptical radii: a / b, four horizontal radii over one vertical, corners with two values, with a border (the inner curve follows the border widths), four border colours and widths, percentages per axis. Tolerance: the anti-aliased edge of a curve where it is nearly tangent to a pixel row or column: the engine fades it linearly over 1.1 px (feathering over 4x multisampling), Skia uses the covered area; such pixels differ by up to about 30 levels (scattered single pixels, no shape difference).
